name: FROZEN IN FEAR : Don't Blink
summary:
**Don't. Blink.**

In Frozen in Fear VR, the mannequins only move when you're not looking... and they're getting closer.

Play solo or with friends in this tense multiplayer horror where lifeless statues, mannequins, and figures come alive once possessed. They're silent. They're patient. And the moment you turn away - they strike.

Every game is different: enemies spawn in new places, move unpredictably, and force your team to watch each other's backs. Blink, and you might be the next victim.
